Retained-task athletes change neither target nor output while a new hinge variant is taught. Actual smaller opportunity histories can use the explicit one- or two-opportunity cap; faults consume an opportunity and never create debt.

entries.set_purpose: One hip set has the named job selected before release: retain actual unloaded control; teach a small unloaded set when history is unknown; retain a familiar two-DB variation; or learn the new two-implement setup and controlled hinge at a manageable load. A first DB set changes grip/arm position, handling and resistance as one newly taught variant, not merely a numerical weight increase. Prior two sets are deliberately reduced to one; recent one-set/low-repetition work stays small.
entries.prior_current_next: Actual OR-02 hip dose, any more recent OR-03/04/05 dose and direct equivalent evidence → one retained/reduced or explicitly taught small hinge set → OR-15 chooses hold/simplify/progress from actual response while landing remains unchanged; OR-19 checks that actual entry. Missing history never becomes an invented two-set or loaded baseline.
entries.advance_hold_regress: Choose the route from actual variation and response, then choose repetitions from the actual recent compatible dose. D does not automatically raise a prior 2/3/3-rep low dose to 3/4/4. A first-flight attempt cannot accompany a loaded hinge route. A load increase is never required; familiar DB routes hold their actual pair, and first-DB instruction uses a manageable verified light pair without mid-set increases. Record a lower completed dose/stop when necessary. The next relevant hinge decision uses this actual response.
